summary: Flag-selected virtual fetch. Reads the flag word at a2[6], chooses a target object by its bits (bit0 -> a2[2], bit1 -> a2[3], otherwise a2 itself), invokes the virtual slot at vtable offset 32 on that object with an 8-dword out buffer v7, stores the result into this[0], returns 255 on a non-zero result, otherwise calls sub_55C450 with a result-dependent first argument (21 when v7[0]==22, else v7[0]) and returns a2.

local_names.a2: parameter object whose flag word and embedded object pointers drive the call
local_names.v4: object selected by the flag bits for the virtual call
local_names.v5: return value of the virtual call
local_names.v7: 8-dword out buffer receiving the virtual call result

operations.description: Load the flag word v3 = a2[6] and branch on its bits.
Select the target object pointer v4: bit0 (value 1) set -> a2[2]; else bit1 (value 2) set -> a2[3]; else v4 = a2 itself.
Indirect __stdcall virtual call through the selected object's vtable: v5 = (*(*v4 + 32))(v4, v7), slot at byte offset 32, passing v7 as an 8-dword out buffer.
Store the virtual call result into the first dword: this[0] (byte offset 0x0) = v5.
If v5 is non-zero, return 255 and skip the sub_55C450 dispatch.
Dispatch by the out-buffer value: when v7[0] equals 22 call sub_55C450(21, 0, &a2), otherwise call sub_55C450(v7[0], 0, &a2).

unresolved: The identity of the class behind the selected object and the purpose of the virtual slot at vtable offset 32 are unidentified.
The semantics of the v7[0] sentinel (22 mapped to argument 21) and why the function returns a2 are not established.
